children: Overview
Hong Kong magnesium producer's interim revenue fell sharply from prior yr
Company reported gross loss and loss for the period
Results are unaudited interim figures for six months ended 30 June 2026
Outlook
Xinjiang Tengxiang intends to temporarily suspend production during semi-coke facility upgrades to meet environmental directives
Baishan Tian'an's stone powder production line is expected to expand business channels and contribute to Group revenue
Magnesium industry supply-demand dynamics are unlikely to improve in H2, with July-August a demand off-season
Result Drivers
MAGNESIUM MARKET WEAKNESS – Revenue fell 67.5% as sales volume dropped to 1,680 tonnes from 6,165 tonnes and average selling prices remained weak
COST CONTROLS – Administrative expenses fell to HK$29.3 mln from HK$31.1 mln, mainly due to continued cost-control measures
DEBT-SERVICE COSTS – Finance costs rose to HK$29.6 mln from HK$27.5 mln, led by effective interest on creditors' scheme borrowings and convertible bonds
